question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.1
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'nearly.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 nearly
 almost, or not completely. (लगभग, या पूरी तरह से नहीं)
 
 

 fairly
 used to emphasize figurative expressions that describe what people or objects are doing. (लाक्षणिक अभिव्यक्तियों पर जोर देने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो वर्णन करता है कि लोग या वस्तुएं क्या कर रही हैं)
 
 

 usually
 in the way that most often happens. (जिस तरह से अक्सर होता है)
 
 

 quite
 used to express that you are not certain about something. (व्यक्त करते थे कि आप किसी चीज़ के बारे में निश्चित नहीं हैं)
 
 
 
 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: "In August every year, thousands of twins descend on a town in Ohio called Twinsburg, named by identical twin brothers **_______** two centuries ago."
 
• We can say the implied meaning of the sentence every August, thousands of twins congregate in Ohio's Twinsburg, which was founded **almost 200 years ago** by identical twin brothers.
 
• Here we have to use the adverb of time and distance, which is **'nearly'** in context to almost 200 years ago.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "nearly" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​
